text_help_content:
Uyu mutambo wetiki-toe.

Mutambi wemunhu anoshandisa chiratidzo cheX, mutambi weAI anoshandisa chiratidzo cheO. Ndiani anogona kuisa zviratidzo zvitatu mumutsara (yakatwasuka, yakatwasuka kana diagonal) anokunda.

Kuti uchinje chinhanho chekuoma, tinya pane icon yekumisikidza. Ikoko iwe unogona kushandura mutauro weiye mushandisi interface zvakare.

Kuti utangezve mutambo, tinya pane yekutanga patsva icon.

text_about_content3:
App yewebhu iyi yakadudzirwa kuti zvikuitire nyore uchishandisa software yekushandura inofambiswa neGoogle Dudziro. Kuyedza kunonzwisisika kwakaitwa kupa shanduro chaiyo, zvisinei, hapana shanduro yakazvimiririra haina kukwana kana kuitirwa kutsiva vashanduri vevanhu. Dudziro dzinopihwa sevhisi kune vashandisi vewe marcoparrone.com webhusaiti, uye zvinopihwa "sezvazviri." Hapana garandi yerudzi rupi zvarwo, ingave yakaratidzwa kana kurehwa, inoitwa nezvekururama, kuvimbika, kana kururamisa kweshanduro dzese dzakaitwa kubva kuChirungu kuenda mune chero mumwe mutauro. Zvimwe zvirimo (zvakadai semifananidzo, mavhidhiyo, Flash, nezvimwewo) zvinogona kutadza kunyatsodudzirwa nekuda kwekukanganisa kwesoftware yekushandura.

Chinyorwa chepamutemo ndicho chinyorwa cheChirungu chewebhusaiti. Chero kusanzwanana kana mutsauko unogadzirwa mushanduro hausunge uye hauna mvumo yepamutemo yekuteerera kana kuita zvinangwa. Kana paine chero mibvunzo inomuka inoenderana nekururama kweruzivo rwuri muwebhusaiti yakashandurwa, tarisa kune yeChirungu vhezheni yewebhusaiti inova iyo yepamutemo vhezheni.
